entries.source: SSW(i)-এ পরিবার আনা যায়?
entries.target: Can family be brought in SSW(i)?

entries.source: না। Official overview অনুযায়ী SSW(i)-এ family accompaniment অনুমোদিত নয়।
entries.target: No. According to the official overview, family accompaniment is not allowed in SSW(i).

entries.source: SSW(ii)-এ পরিবার আনা যায়?
entries.target: Can family be brought in SSW(ii)?

entries.source: প্রযোজ্য immigration rules পূরণ করলে family আনার সুযোগ আছে। SSW(ii)-এর stay duration-এ নির্দিষ্ট upper limit নেই।
entries.target: There is an opportunity to bring family if applicable immigration rules are met. There is no specific upper limit on the stay duration for SSW(ii).

entries.source: SSW(i)-এ এখন কয়টি field?
entries.target: How many fields are there now in SSW(i)?

entries.source: বর্তমান official overview ১৯টি field তালিকাভুক্ত করে। নতুন কয়েকটি field-এর implementation/details পর্যায়ক্রমে প্রকাশ হচ্ছে।
entries.target: The current official overview lists 19 fields. Implementation/details of several new fields are being released gradually.

entries.source: সব field-এ JLPT N4 বা JFT-Basic হলেই হবে?
entries.target: Will JLPT N4 or JFT-Basic be enough for all fields?

entries.source: না। অনেক field-এ এটি সাধারণ language route হলেও কিছু field/occupation-এ higher বা additional requirement আছে। নিজের field-এর official requirement দেখুন।
entries.target: No. Although this is a common language route for many fields, some fields/occupations have higher or additional requirements. Check the official requirements for your field.

entries.source: বাংলাদেশে কোন SSW exam এখন আছে?
entries.target: Which SSW exams are currently available in Bangladesh?

entries.source: Schedule দ্রুত বদলায়। Official Test Information page-এ country এবং date অনুযায়ী current schedule দেখুন।
entries.target: Schedules change quickly. Check the current schedule by country and date on the Official Test Information page.

entries.source: SSW(ii)-এ যেতে আগে ঠিক ৫ বছর SSW(i) করতেই হবে?
entries.target: Is it necessary to complete exactly 5 years of SSW(i) before moving to SSW(ii)?

entries.source: একটি universal “ঠিক ৫ বছর” rule ধরে নেওয়া ঠিক নয়। SSW(ii)-এর advanced skill/experience requirement field অনুযায়ী আলাদা।
entries.target: It is not correct to assume a universal “exactly 5 years” rule. The advanced skill/experience requirements for SSW(ii) vary by field.

entries.source: Fixed মাসিক salary কত?
entries.target: What is the fixed monthly salary?

entries.source: Universal fixed salary নেই। Region, employer, occupation, experience ও overtime অনুযায়ী আয় বদলায়; remuneration comparable Japanese worker-এর সমপর্যায়ের হওয়া প্রয়োজন।
entries.target: There is no universal fixed salary. Income varies based on region, employer, occupation, experience, and overtime; remuneration must be at the same level as a comparable Japanese worker.

entries.source: SSC/JSC পাস কি universal SSW requirement?
entries.target: Is passing SSC/JSC a universal SSW requirement?

entries.source: General official overview-এ universal “SSC/JSC minimum” হিসেবে এমন blanket requirement নেই। Field, test, employment এবং country-specific procedure আলাদা হতে পারে।
entries.target: The general official overview does not have such a blanket requirement as a universal “SSC/JSC minimum.” Fields, tests, employment, and country-specific procedures may differ.

entries.source: SSW rules ও test schedule পরিবর্তিত হতে পারে। আবেদন করার আগে Immigration Services Agency-এর latest information মিলিয়ে নিন।
entries.target: SSW rules and test schedules are subject to change. Check the latest information from the Immigration Services Agency before applying.
